Tests batch bytes extraction with per-input config (extract_batch)

```typescript title="TypeScript"
import { ExtractInput, ExtractInputKind, extractBatch } from "@xberg-io/xberg";
async function main() {
  const result = await extractBatch([{ bytes: await (await import("node:fs/promises")).readFile("pdf/fake_memo.pdf"), config: { outputFormat: "markdown" }, filename: "fake_memo.pdf", kind: ExtractInputKind.Bytes } as ExtractInput]);
  console.log(result.results?.[0]?.mimeType);
  console.log(result.results?.[0]?.content);
  console.log(result.results?.[0]?.metadata?.outputFormat);
}

void main();
```
